purpose: Teach: 一撃/行財政/主審/官民/裏づけ/等価/定型/総勢

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 競合に一撃を与える戦略を立てましょう
lines.en: Let's develop a strategy to deliver a decisive blow to the competition.
lines.style: Brisk and forward-leaning. Energetic opening. Confident tempo. The tone of someone who's already thinking two moves ahead. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地方の行財政動向を分析します
lines.en: Understood. I'll analyze the local government and fiscal trends.
lines.style: Steady, responsive. A brief nod in the voice. Practical and ready to move. The tone of someone who's already mentally organizing the work.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: コンペの主審を引き受けましょう
lines.en: And let's take on the role of judge for the competition.
lines.style: Clear directive. Measured pace. The voice of someone accustomed to being heard and respected. A slight lift at the end — not asking, deciding together.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。官民連携の好事例を集めます
lines.en: Got it. I'll gather successful examples of public-private partnerships.
lines.style: Crisp confirmation. Quick intake of breath. Efficient and aligned. The tone of someone keeping pace with momentum without losing precision.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 提案には裏づけ資料を添えましょう
lines.en: Let's attach supporting documentation to the proposal.
lines.style: Firm and reasoned. Steady voice. The tempo of someone laying out non-negotiable standards without making it personal. Slight emphasis on 'attach.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。給与体系を等価な原則で整えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll structure the pay scale around equitable principles.
lines.style: Assured affirmation. A note of quiet competence. The tempo of someone who understands the stakes and isn't rushing. Grounded.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 定型書類のテンプレ化を進めましょう
lines.en: Let's move forward with templating the standard forms.
lines.style: Steady and directive. The voice of someone consolidating gains. Even pacing. The faint confidence of a plan coming into shape.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。総勢五十名の研修を計画します
lines.en: Absolutely. I'll plan the training program for all fifty staff members.
lines.style: Full confirmation. A note of quiet accomplishment closing the list. The tone of someone who's moving from planning into execution. Anchored and complete.
